text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research paper focused primarily on land use/cover (LULC) prediction for Romania at the national scale (entire country). The study uses the CLUE-S model to simulate future LULC changes specifically related to agricultural lands, implementing two distinct future scenarios based on past change rates (1990-2000 and 2000-2006). The methodology includes spatially explicit modeling with a resolution of 500 m and reports quantitative accuracy metrics such as Overall Accuracy and Kappa index for model validation. The outputs include mapped LULC projections and detailed quantitative comparisons of different agricultural land use change flows across major relief units. The study meets all core inclusion criteria: explicit national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation, use of ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy assessment, and mapped projections. It does not meet any exclusion criteria. It is not a review article but an original research paper.)
